programmes.d: Juliette takes great pains to keep Maddie from learning the truth. Deacon considers a new artist for Highway 65. Scarlett's pregnancy faces complications. Gunnar searches for the mugger.
Gunnar goes to his hometown and faces the ghosts of his past; Maddie and Juliette find themselves nominated for the same music award; Deacon helps Jessie record; Scarlett learns self-defense.
Zoe tries to convince a reporter that she has a thriving medical practice. George informs Lemon that he is going out on a date, making her feel that she too needs to find a date.
While Zoe tries to keep things casual with Wade, she becomes jealous after she sees him with another woman. Lavon reluctantly agrees to let Lemon be his campaign manager.
Zoe is shocked to find that George may be sleepwalking. AnnaBeth (KAITLYN BLACK) has an unusual plan that may help Lavon clinch the mayoral election against Ruby (GOLDEN BROOKS).
As the mayoral election looms, Lavon and Ruby (Golden Brooks) are tied in the polls; Lemon uses creative methods to try to win and George and Wade try to secure last-minute votes.
A boy on the high school football team has a crush on Zoe. The town encourages her to wait until after the big game to end it. Olympic gold medalist Mckayla Maroney guest stars.
Zoe and Lemon are having a tough time accepting Lavon and Ruby's (Golden Brooks) new relationship. A talk with George makes Wade see his relationship in a different light.
Despite Zoe's apprehensions, she decides to bid on Wade's basket at the charity picnic auction, but is surprised she is not the only one. Lemon mistakenly wins Lavon's basket.
In order to avoid spending quality time with her mother, who is visiting BlueBell, Zoe potentially ruins Christmas Eve for the whole town.
BlueBell's Pioneer Day is approaching and Zoe and Wade volunteer to help out Lavon by playing the town's "Founding Couple." George gives Brick advice.
George's parents are thrown upon meeting his new girlfriend, Tansy (Mircea Monroe). George's mother devises a plan forcing George and Zoe to address their feelings for one another.
When a flu epidemic heads toward BlueBell, Zoe puts the town on lockdown -- but gets jealous when Wade must stay at his ex-girlfriend's house. Lemon's plans go awry.
George panics when Tansy's (Mircea Monroe) dog goes missing on his watch. Zoe is focused on not losing her good status to a new doctor (Travis Van Winkle -- Transformers).
Wade's excited to compete in the Battle of the Bands contest, but Zoe's suggestion that George play with him backfires. Lemon and Magnolia (Claudia Lee) do some sisterly bonding.
Zoe agrees to be maid of honor for Wanda (Mallory Moye) at her wedding, which entails the difficult job of watching Wanda's mother (Debra Jo Rupp - That '70s Show).
Zoe tries to keep her feelings about Wade under control. Lavon and Wade are forced to work together at the church's casino fundraiser, but when money is missing, Wade is suspected.
Ruby Jeffries (Golden Brooks) helps out when Lavon's plans to make BlueBell a Spring Break spot hit a roadblock. George is jealous to see Zoe with Jonah (Travis Van Winkle).

Juliette shoots a mascara commercial but takes issue with the direction. Deacon gets invited to play the Opry, but hesitates. Avery and Gunnar embrace life on the road.
With Deacon and the artists of Highway 65 taking a stand, Zach sends a message. Maddie and Juliette’s conflict comes to a head. Daphne goes to a pool party. Gunnar returns from Avery’s tour.
Deacon fights loneliness. Juliette seeks personal change. Maddie meets a hot new pop star. Gunnar and Scarlett struggle to find separate ways. Will tries to keep smiling after a breakup.
Deacon goes on a date. Juliette dives into a self-help movement. Will and Gunnar ask Avery to perform with them. Scarlett is reminded of her influence on fans. Daphne reaches out to Jake.
Daphne mulls over Deacon dating. Juliette introduces Avery to Darius. Maddie and Jonah record a song, but she thinks his life is too public. Will gets news about Zach and enhances his look.
Darius helps Juliette unlock a dark secret. Daphne and Jake share an unexpected bond. Scarlett volunteers at an equine therapy ranch. Gunnar, Will, and Avery struggle to find their sound.
Dr. Brown, Ephram and Delia are all shocked by a visit from Dr. Brown's estranged father. Meanwhile, Ephram and Amy take Bright out to celebrate his 21st birthday.
